ambient: The rack cycles a relay, correctly, for nothing.
The mast takes a gust from a wind that isn't here.
A cooling fan spins up, does its job, and spins down.
description: A concrete hut on nothing, with a mast on it and an equipment rack inside that's entirely lit and entirely idle. It has power. It has been serviced. It's relaying, faithfully and at full strength, an absence.
name: The Repeater Hut

looks: Every light green. Every meter at zero.
Serviced recently. There's a signature on the card and it has run.
It's retransmitting something. You can tell by how carefully it's doing it.
objects.name: the rack

looks: Guy-wired, painted, correct. Going up further than the sky is.
It hums, once, in weather that isn't happening.
There's a red light at the top for aircraft. There are no aircraft.
objects.name: the mast

weather: The mast takes a gust from a wind that isn't happening. The red light at the top blinks for aircraft that aren't coming.
